description: Source code for a DID (Decentralized Identifier) management service, including functions for registration, resolution, partial updates, deregistration, and registry management within a blockchain or decentralized identity system.

classes.name: DIDService
classes.description: Service for managing Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs), including creation, resolution, partial updates, and registry management.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DID service, creating a master seed and registry if needed.

methods.name: GetAgentFieldServerID
methods.description: Returns the agent field server ID for this DID service instance.

methods.name: validateAgentFieldServerRegistry
methods.description: Ensures that the agent field server registry exists before performing operations.

methods.name: GetRegistry
methods.description: Retrieves the DID registry for a given agent field server ID.

methods.name: RegisterAgent
methods.description: Generates DIDs for an agent node and its components, supporting partial updates if the agent exists.

methods.name: handleNewRegistration
methods.description: Handles registration logic for new agents.

methods.name: ResolveDID
methods.description: Resolves a DID to its public key and metadata.

methods.name: generateDIDWithKeys
methods.description: Generates a DID along with private and public keys from a master seed and derivation path.

methods.name: generateDIDFromSeed
methods.description: Creates a DID from a seed and derivation path.

methods.name: derivePrivateKey
methods.description: Derives an Ed25519 private key from a seed and derivation path.

methods.name: generateDIDKey
methods.description: Creates a DID:key identifier from an Ed25519 public key.

methods.name: ed25519PrivateKeyToJWK
methods.description: Converts an Ed25519 private key to JWK format.

methods.name: ed25519PublicKeyToJWK
methods.description: Converts an Ed25519 public key to JWK format.

methods.name: hashAgentFieldServerID
methods.description: Creates a hash of the agent field server ID for derivation paths.

methods.name: regeneratePrivateKeyJWK
methods.description: Regenerates a private key JWK from seed and derivation path.

methods.name: regeneratePublicKeyJWK
methods.description: Regenerates a public key JWK from seed and derivation path.

methods.name: ListAllAgentDIDs
methods.description: Lists all registered agent DIDs.

methods.name: BackfillExistingNodes
methods.description: Registers existing nodes without DIDs into the system.

methods.name: GetExistingAgentDID
methods.description: Retrieves existing DID info for an agent node.

methods.name: PerformDifferentialAnalysis
methods.description: Compares existing and new reasoners/skills to determine updates needed.

methods.name: setDifference
methods.description: Returns elements in one slice not present in another.

methods.name: setIntersection
methods.description: Returns common elements between two slices.

methods.name: extractReasonerIDs
methods.description: Extracts reasoner IDs from reasoner definitions.

methods.name: extractSkillIDs
methods.description: Extracts skill IDs from skill definitions.

methods.name: findReasonerByID
methods.description: Finds a reasoner definition by ID.

methods.name: findSkillByID
methods.description: Finds a skill definition by ID.

methods.name: generateReasonerPath
methods.description: Generates a derivation path for a reasoner.

methods.name: generateSkillPath
methods.description: Generates a derivation path for a skill.

methods.name: buildExistingIdentityPackage
methods.description: Builds an identity package from existing agent DID info.

methods.name: handlePartialRegistration
methods.description: Handles partial registration updates for an existing agent.

methods.name: PartialRegisterAgent
methods.description: Registers only new components for an existing agent.

methods.name: DeregisterComponents
methods.description: Removes specified components from an agent's DID registry.
